name: Upside-Down Waterfall
description: A stream of water rises from the lake toward the clouds and vanishes high above.

scenes.name: Rising Stream
scenes.description: Droplets fall upward, gaining speed as they approach the clouds.

scenes.name: Floating Stones
scenes.description: Wet river stones of various sizes hang motionless above the shore.

scenes.name: Dry Riverbed
scenes.description: Beyond the lake stretches a riverbed through which water once flowed in the usual way.
